text:
emma: quick note from sparrow-lite-q3 onboard: streaming funcall parse failures ~2% (10k calls). mostly trailing suffix fragments.
raj: sync ok?
emma: sync fine. streaming chunk boundaries correlate. sample 55599 reproducible.
sara: paste failing capture?
emma: logged chunks:
```
{"tool":"search","args":{"q":"sourdough"}}

{"tool":"open_url","args":{"url":"http://r.example/b"}}

]}
```
raj: stray closing bracket in new chunk. parser errors on `]}`.
ci-bot: canary start 1749987600 cfg stream_chunk=512 kv_cache=on
mike: numbers?
emma: 198 json-lint flags -> 1.98%. taxonomy 60% suffix,30% ctrlchar,10% reorder.
sara: hypothesis: quantized tokenizer shift causes more mid-structure cuts.
raj: can we force token-splits to repro?
emma: byte-split fuzzing repro: v0.3.1 ~90% for targeted splits vs baseline v0.2.9 ~4%.
mike: any lightweight heal?
sara: propose streaming-rescue: on parse fail attempt wrapper-salvage: join non-empty chunks with commas, wrap in array, try json.loads.
emma: prototype cut failures to 0.6% in trial. example: `wrapped = '[' + ','.join(chunks_filtered) + ']'` then parse.
mike: good but audit semantics. add semantic-eval after salvage.
sara: will add unit tests (truncation, ctrlchar, interleave) + fuzz integration. redact logs but retain raw stream for audit.
raj: I'll add token-split repro harness and run nightly fuzz.
ci-bot: post-patch trial 1749987800 failure_rate 0.6% health improved
mike: rollout: behind flag, enable only for q3 quant families, monitor parsed_tool_count and eval score; rollback if semantic delta >0.5%.
emma: opening PR, please monitor dashboards 48h. :eyes:
